lessons.task: Predict straight motion, a left arc and pure spin from wheel speeds.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The mean rim speed sets translation while the difference divided by track width sets yaw; world displacement must rotate with heading.
lessons.claim_limit: No lateral slip or wheel-radius calibration error is estimated.

lessons.task: Compose two planar frame changes and reverse their order.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Translation rotates with its parent frame; use the inverse transform for a round trip, not a negated translation in the wrong frame.
lessons.claim_limit: A valid inverse does not prove the transform represents a calibrated sensor.

lessons.task: Predict the endpoint with the elbow straight and then folded.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Ordered rotations produce a sum of link vectors; equal links can cancel at a folded elbow although joint angles remain finite.
lessons.claim_limit: Planar rigid links omit compliance and joint offsets.

lessons.task: Explain why an unreachable target must be rejected before clipping the cosine.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The annular workspace has both inner and outer boundaries; elbow branches can share an endpoint while differing in joint configuration.
lessons.claim_limit: A small algebraic residual does not establish collision-free motion.

lessons.task: Predict current and speed when gear ratio changes under load.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Back EMF couples speed to current; gearing changes reflected inertia and output torque rather than creating mechanical power.
lessons.claim_limit: The motor model does not qualify thermal limits or gearbox backlash.

lessons.task: Separate speed tracking, saturation and integral windup.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Accumulated error can demand unavailable voltage; recovery depends on the stored integral as well as the present speed error.
lessons.claim_limit: A deterministic speed step is not a robustness certificate for every load.

lessons.task: Compute endpoint velocity and acceleration for the displayed trajectory.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Differentiate the interpolation polynomial and check endpoints, extrema and physical units; sample spacing alone does not guarantee smooth motion.
lessons.claim_limit: A smooth reference can exceed actuator acceleration or torque limits.

lessons.task: Predict contact displacement when stiffness changes with fixed force.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Impedance sets a force-motion relationship; environment stiffness participates in the coupled dynamics and damping dissipates energy.
lessons.claim_limit: Stable sampled plots do not prove passivity against every environment.

lessons.task: Estimate encoder resolution and the speed ripple caused by quantization.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Position increments are discrete counts; differentiation divides quantization error by sample time and can amplify it.
lessons.claim_limit: Higher sampling alone cannot create additional encoder resolution.

lessons.task: Predict position drift from a constant accelerometer bias.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Velocity bias grows linearly and position bias quadratically with coast time; angular and translational errors have different units.
lessons.claim_limit: This one-axis drift study does not execute full inertial navigation.

lessons.task: Separate a range-sensor blind zone from random-looking measurement variation.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Compare true distance, bias, saturation and invalid-return rules before summarizing residuals; an invalid return is not a physical zero range.
lessons.claim_limit: Synthetic perturbations do not identify a real sensor noise distribution.

lessons.task: Recover a sensor transform and check a held-out point.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Rigid calibration must preserve distances and orientation; fit rotation and translation jointly and evaluate points outside the fit set.
lessons.claim_limit: Collinear or poorly spread observations can conceal calibration ambiguity.

lessons.task: Compare exact planar arc integration with a straight-line approximation.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Encoder increments determine both heading and displacement; rotation during a sample changes the world-frame endpoint.
lessons.claim_limit: Agreement under no-slip motion does not estimate wheel slip.

lessons.task: Trace a wheel/absolute-position observation through EKF prediction and correction.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The motion Jacobian propagates pose covariance; an innovation changes state through its gain and must also update covariance.
lessons.claim_limit: Small error in one deterministic trajectory is not statistical consistency.

lessons.task: Explain particle weights, effective sample size and resampling diversity.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Bayes weights favor compatible poses, normalization preserves probability mass, and resampling trades weight degeneracy for duplicate hypotheses.
lessons.claim_limit: A concentrated particle set can converge to a wrong mode.

lessons.task: Identify the unknown landmark and the global translation gauge.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Odometry constrains differences; landmark observations couple pose and map variables; one absolute anchor removes the common translation ambiguity.
lessons.claim_limit: The linear one-dimensional graph does not establish nonlinear planar SLAM.

lessons.task: Predict whether changing a heuristic preserves shortest-path optimality.
lessons.expected_reasoning: An admissible estimate changes search order without overestimating remaining cost; obstacle occupancy determines feasibility independently.
lessons.claim_limit: Finite grid resolution can hide passages or inflate obstacles.

lessons.task: Explain why node collision checks do not certify sampled-tree edges.
lessons.expected_reasoning: A valid connection must clear the entire segment; a tree path must follow actual parent links back to the start.
lessons.claim_limit: Finite sampling offers neither guaranteed success nor a universal optimality bound.

lessons.task: Predict a moving-obstacle conflict using synchronized relative motion.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Evaluate robot and obstacle positions at the same future time and include stopping or waiting as an executed action.
lessons.claim_limit: A finite candidate set can miss a feasible avoidance maneuver.

lessons.task: Reconstruct a behavior-tree tick from child status and traversal order.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Sequence and fallback nodes propagate running, success and failure differently; trace which children actually execute.
lessons.claim_limit: A diagram without tick semantics cannot establish recovery behavior.

lessons.task: Show which guard permits a mission-state transition.
lessons.expected_reasoning: State, event and guard jointly determine the next action; a recovery transition must preserve or explicitly reset its evidence.
lessons.claim_limit: A finite mission model does not enumerate every field failure.

lessons.task: Compute a deadline miss from release, execution and response time.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Interference and blocking affect completion time; utilization alone does not prove every job meets its deadline.
lessons.claim_limit: A simulated schedule is not a real operating-system latency measurement.

lessons.task: Distinguish detection time from achieving a safe state.
lessons.expected_reasoning: A monitor must observe a relevant fault, decide within its threshold and cause a bounded fallback; inspect the actual state after the alarm.
lessons.claim_limit: Passing injected faults is not safety certification or complete fault coverage.

lessons.task: Follow a delayed command through a watchdog and virtual plant.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Source age determines command validity; fail-zero behavior and plant response must be visible after packet loss.
lessons.claim_limit: Software-only HIL methodology is not physical HIL evidence.

lessons.task: Check both radial constraint residual and tangent-velocity projection.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The constraint Jacobian removes the radial velocity component; instantaneous tangency does not guarantee finite-step collision freedom.
lessons.claim_limit: The circle example is a configuration-space slice, not general manifold planning.

lessons.task: Compare rigid pose composition with elementwise matrix interpolation.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Proper rotations preserve orthogonality and determinant one; translation and rotation composition generally do not commute.
lessons.claim_limit: A valid SE(3) matrix does not establish a correct sensor-frame convention.

lessons.task: Preserve mechanical power while changing twist and wrench frames.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Angular and linear velocity transform together with the lever-arm term; the dual wrench map preserves their scalar power product.
lessons.claim_limit: Omitting translation can remain hidden when force or angular velocity is zero.

lessons.task: Predict Jacobian rank near a straight or folded elbow.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Singular values measure local directional mobility; finite perturbations of forward kinematics check derivative signs and link contributions.
lessons.claim_limit: A nonsingular instantaneous Jacobian does not ensure global reachability.

lessons.task: Separate desired task velocity from secondary null-space motion.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The projector should suppress the secondary task-space contribution; damping alters the primary inverse and its residual.
lessons.claim_limit: Large finite integration steps can invalidate an instantaneous null-space argument.

lessons.task: Derive joint torques from a specified end-effector wrench.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Virtual work equates task and joint power, giving a Jacobian-transpose mapping with explicit force and moment units.
lessons.claim_limit: A static torque map does not include inertia, friction or saturation.

lessons.task: Check inertia symmetry, positive energy and the Coriolis skew identity.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Kinetic energy defines inertia; configuration derivatives produce coupling terms, while gravity is the potential gradient.
lessons.claim_limit: A positive inertia matrix alone does not validate every dynamic term.

lessons.task: Separate parameter fitting from held-out torque prediction.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Excitation determines regressor rank; fit residual and parameter error must be checked separately on new motion.
lessons.claim_limit: Low residual on an unexciting trajectory does not identify unique parameters.

lessons.task: Find the trajectory duration required by both speed and acceleration limits.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Time scaling changes first derivatives inversely with duration and second derivatives inversely with duration squared.
lessons.claim_limit: A sample-only extrema check may miss between-sample limit violations.

lessons.task: Compare joint-space tracking with task-space error under the same plant.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Joint errors map through geometry; task commands need a consistent Jacobian and can demand large rates near singularity.
lessons.claim_limit: A task-space path is not automatically actuator-feasible.

lessons.task: Explain the effect of payload mismatch on computed-torque compensation.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Model cancellation uses inertia, coupling and gravity; feedback corrects residual error only within available effort.
lessons.claim_limit: Nominal cancellation is not robust to arbitrary model mismatch.

lessons.task: Compute operational-space inertia and diagnose singular directions.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The task inertia depends on both the Jacobian and joint inertia; null directions require explicit treatment rather than an unstable inverse.
lessons.claim_limit: The bounded example is not whole-body contact planning.

lessons.task: Compare impedance and admittance under the same environment stiffness.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Impedance maps motion error to force; admittance integrates measured force into motion; interface choice changes closed-loop dynamics.
lessons.claim_limit: Stable behavior in one environment does not guarantee passive interaction.

lessons.task: Separate tangential motion control from normal contact-force control.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Projection must respect the surface frame, and unilateral contact prevents tensile wall force when separation occurs.
lessons.claim_limit: A fixed planar surface omits changing contact normals and frictional slip.

lessons.task: Audit the energy tank when saturation and delayed commands occur.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Applied work, not requested work, must be charged to the tank; a nonnegative energy record requires actual command limiting.
lessons.claim_limit: A discrete tank model is not a physical passivity certificate.

lessons.task: Explain the energy-shaping and balance-control switching condition.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The unactuated link receives energy through coupled dynamics; switching depends on angle and rate, not merely elapsed time.
lessons.claim_limit: A successful nominal swing-up is not a global stabilizing guarantee.

lessons.task: Predict pixel motion from depth and camera pose.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Perspective division follows the camera frame; points behind or too near the image plane require explicit handling.
lessons.claim_limit: A pinhole model excludes lens distortion and rolling shutter.

lessons.task: Compare calibration fit error with held-out reprojection error.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Intrinsics and distortion must explain multiple board views; pose diversity matters more than repeating one view.
lessons.claim_limit: Synthetic board calibration does not validate a physical camera.

lessons.task: Explain why detected corners are not yet reliable correspondences.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Local gradient structure determines feature strength; descriptors require consistent sampling and a matching rule.
lessons.claim_limit: Repeatability on a generated scene is not invariance to every viewpoint.

lessons.task: Reject outliers before refitting a geometric correspondence model.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Consensus counts compatible observations; a refit must use the selected inliers rather than all original matches.
lessons.claim_limit: A high inlier fraction can still support the wrong geometric model.

lessons.task: Predict depth uncertainty as disparity approaches zero.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Triangulation couples baseline, focal scale and disparity; far-range depth becomes sensitive even when pixel residuals stay small.
lessons.claim_limit: A finite depth estimate does not prove positive depth in both cameras.

lessons.task: Recover object pose from landmarks and check projection consistency.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Pose changes both rotation and translation of each 3D point; reprojection and cheirality distinguish plausible solutions.
lessons.claim_limit: Known correspondences and an initialized solver do not solve unrestricted object detection.

lessons.task: Explain free-space and occupied updates along a range ray.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Only traversed cells receive free evidence and the endpoint receives occupied evidence; log odds accumulate bounded belief.
lessons.claim_limit: Repeated correlated scans do not provide independent probability evidence.

lessons.task: Separate nearest-neighbor association from rigid-transform fitting.
lessons.expected_reasoning: ICP alternates correspondences and pose updates; residual reduction depends on initialization and overlap.
lessons.claim_limit: A small local residual does not prove global registration correctness.

lessons.task: Predict which state direction becomes unobservable without excitation.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The stacked whitened measurement rows determine rank; sample rate cannot recover a state absent from every row.
lessons.claim_limit: A numerical rank threshold is not a universal sensor-design criterion.

lessons.task: Separate gating from robust weighting of accepted residuals.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Mahalanobis distance tests compatibility; a Huber influence bound limits an accepted outlier without changing its units.
lessons.claim_limit: Two labeled candidates do not demonstrate general combinatorial association.

lessons.task: Show how an unknown landmark changes the nonlinear graph state.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Robot position, heading and landmark coordinates are optimized jointly; relative observations leave three planar gauge freedoms without an anchor.
lessons.claim_limit: Known correspondences and a single initialized circuit omit loop discovery and global SLAM.

lessons.task: Explain why a plausible false loop can deform an entire map.
lessons.expected_reasoning: A robust loss limits the loop's influence while odometry and the anchor resist deformation; inspect distributed map error.
lessons.claim_limit: Robust optimization does not make arbitrary false correspondences harmless.

lessons.task: Distinguish a backward smoother from a causal filter with smaller error bars.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Future measurements affect past states through the smoothing gain; held-out observations audit errors separately from fitting.
lessons.claim_limit: One deterministic trajectory cannot establish probabilistic covariance coverage.

lessons.task: Trace a changed edge through incremental search state.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Reusable cost-to-come and one-step lookahead values must be made consistent after a map change; compare with a cold search.
lessons.claim_limit: Weighted heuristics and tie rules affect expansion counts and optimality claims.

lessons.task: Explain when a roadmap query fails despite many samples.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Free nodes need collision-checked connections; connection radius and graph reachability matter independently of sample count.
lessons.claim_limit: A missing path in a finite roadmap does not prove geometric impossibility.

lessons.task: Verify that rewiring updates descendant costs as well as a parent pointer.
lessons.expected_reasoning: A better connection changes the entire subtree's accumulated cost; the final path must follow the revised ancestry.
lessons.claim_limit: A finite deterministic sample sequence is not an asymptotic optimality demonstration.

lessons.task: Check swept clearance after removing intermediate waypoints.
lessons.expected_reasoning: A shortcut can cross an inflated obstacle even when its endpoints are free; re-evaluate the full segment after smoothing.
lessons.claim_limit: Circular planar obstacles do not represent arbitrary articulated collision geometry.

lessons.task: Separate objective reduction from feasibility restoration.
lessons.expected_reasoning: A smoother path can violate obstacle constraints; inspect every segment and retain fixed endpoints during updates.
lessons.claim_limit: Local constrained optimization does not prove global path optimality.

lessons.task: Reconstruct position and velocity from every bounded acceleration action.
lessons.expected_reasoning: A kinodynamic state includes velocity; reaching the target at nonzero speed is a different goal from terminal rest.
lessons.claim_limit: A finite lattice can fail to represent a feasible continuous trajectory.

lessons.task: Explain why a short prediction horizon changes avoidance decisions.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The selected acceleration is applied to the plant and the horizon is recomputed; a frozen-obstacle prediction uses the wrong future state.
lessons.claim_limit: Finite sampled predictions do not automatically certify between-sample clearance.

lessons.task: Distinguish force closure from supporting one selected external load.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Positive combinations of friction-cone wrenches must span all wrench directions for closure; one feasible load is weaker evidence.
lessons.claim_limit: Unbounded contact effort is not a grasp with finite actuator limits.

lessons.task: Trace observation, approach, grasp verification, transfer and release.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Every task transition must follow measured geometric or contact evidence; endpoint reachability alone cannot prove placement.
lessons.claim_limit: Planar kinematic execution omits full gripper and object-contact dynamics.

lessons.task: Compare base travel with arm dexterity for one target.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Moving the base changes relative target coordinates and arm conditioning; a weighted objective trades travel against singularity avoidance.
lessons.claim_limit: A configuration choice does not establish nonholonomic base trajectory feasibility.

lessons.task: Demonstrate recovery after a motion edge becomes infeasible.
lessons.expected_reasoning: The symbolic plan must use geometric feasibility and retain the actual execution state when selecting an alternative.
lessons.claim_limit: Exhausting all alternatives must report failure rather than invent success.

lessons.task: Check vertex and edge-swap conflicts in a reservation schedule.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Robots can collide by sharing a cell or swapping cells during one step; waits and delayed starts remain part of the schedule.
lessons.claim_limit: Discrete reservations do not certify continuous physical separation.

lessons.task: Trace one encoder value through units, frames and timestamp contracts.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Correct forward kinematics can still consume mis-scaled angles or stale data; check interface validity separately from inverse consistency.
lessons.claim_limit: Self-inverse transform residuals alone cannot detect every frame mistake.

lessons.task: Measure recovery latency from the actual accepted event sequence.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Source time and arrival time serve different roles; stale rejection, gap detection and fresh-state recovery must be observable.
lessons.claim_limit: A synthetic replay is not middleware or clock-synchronization qualification.

lessons.task: Connect a sensor observation to map, state estimate, route and executed motion.
lessons.expected_reasoning: Map and estimator outputs must feed planning and control; assess freshness, swept clearance, goal progress and recovery separately.
lessons.claim_limit: A bounded deterministic mission does not establish field autonomy or safety certification.

lessons.task: Connect visual pose, arm motion, grasp force and object placement.
lessons.expected_reasoning: A grasp verdict must depend on executed arm/contact behavior and the object's final state; unrelated successful components do not prove integration.
lessons.claim_limit: Synthetic planar manipulation is not hardware or general 3D manipulation qualification.
